sources.title: GitHub - Terry-ferns13/LegalGPT: LegalGPT is a fully localized AI ...
sources.snippet: LegalGPT is a fully localized AI chatbot that enables law firms to search and query their confidential legal documents using natural language—without sending any data to the cloud. Built with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), it runs entirely on your infrastructure, ensuring complete data sovereignty and attorney-client privilege compliance.
